system.name: DiffKV
system.one_liner: a framework that differentiates KV cache compression by key/value role, token importance, and per-head sparsity to cut LLM serving memory cost

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: batches as many requests as possible within available GPU memory and sends them to all workers

components.name: Worker-0
components.role: executes a partition of the model on one GPU

components.name: Memory Manager
components.role: oversees the KV cache for the worker's assigned attention heads

components.name: Head-0
components.role: groups KV cache entries belonging to one attention head

components.name: Head-1
components.role: groups KV cache entries belonging to one attention head

components.name: Req-0
components.role: per-request KV cache allocation slot within a head

components.name: Req-1
components.role: per-request KV cache allocation slot within a head

components.name: Execution Engine
components.role: performs model computation using the compressed KV cache

components.name: Custom Attention
components.role: custom GPU attention kernel that computes the attention output using the compressed KV cache

components.name: KV Compressor
components.role: compresses key and value vectors following the differentiated compression policy before storing them in the KV cache

components.name: Worker-N
components.role: executes a partition of the model on another GPU

components.name: Head-2N
components.role: groups KV cache entries belonging to one attention head

components.name: Head-2N+1
components.role: groups KV cache entries belonging to one attention head

content.key_idea: A shared scheduler dispatches batched requests to replicated, per-GPU workers, each running an independent memory manager (organized by attention head) alongside an execution engine with a custom attention kernel and KV compressor.
content.reading_order: Top-down: starts at the Scheduler box, follows the dispatch arrows down to Worker-0 and Worker-N, then reads each worker's Memory Manager above its Execution Engine.

summary: This figure shows the overall architecture of DiffKV, a memory-management framework for LLM serving. At the top, a Scheduler batches requests within available GPU memory and dispatches them to multiple Worker boxes (Worker-0 through Worker-N), each running on one GPU and executing a partition of the model. Every worker contains a Memory Manager, organized by attention head (Head-0, Head-1, ... Head-2N+1), with each head holding per-request KV cache slots (Req-0, Req-1), plus an Execution Engine containing a Custom Attention kernel and a KV Compressor that compresses key/value vectors before storing them. The repeated, side-by-side worker layout with an ellipsis conveys that DiffKV's differentiated, per-head memory management scales identically across all GPU workers in the deployment.
summary_zh: 该图展示了DiffKV的整体架构:调度器批处理请求并分发给多个GPU工作节点;每个工作节点内含按注意力头组织的内存管理器(含请求级KV槽位)和执行引擎(含自定义注意力核与KV压缩器),并列结构表示可跨GPU复制扩展。
notes: The figure itself draws the connecting lines with arrowheads pointing toward the Scheduler; the Scheduler-to-Worker dispatch direction used here follows the paper text rather than the visual arrowhead orientation.
